tools.name: analyze_rental
tools.description: Analyze a US residential property as a rental investment. Give an address or the key facts (price, beds, baths, square feet, ZIP). Add any numbers the user knows, such as their expected rent, tax or insurance; they override our estimates. Returns an investment score, IRR over a 15-year hold, monthly

tools.name: deal_score
tools.description: Look up NestCalc's independent Deal Score for a for-sale listing, or list the current top deals (WINs) in a covered city. Scores are published for every listing, including low ones, and are never changed for anyone. Covered today: Cincinnati. For any other property, use analyze_rental. Not an apprai
